settings.comment: Maximum number of cached map page textures kept in GPU memory before old off-screen pages are evicted.
Maximum number of FastMap page components kept in RAM after GPU textures are evicted. Higher values make pan-back faster at the cost of memory.
Maximum number of loaded/generated page snapshots allowed to wait for main-thread upload. Keeps fallback generation from outrunning uploads and hoarding RAM.
Group uploaded map pages into larger GPU atlas textures. This reduces texture object churn and can improve large-map loading and panning.
Write sparse LZ4-compressed cache files. Disable to write the older raw pages-v1 format.
Write pages-v3 cache files using a channel-shuffle filter before LZ4 compression. This may reduce cache size for some worlds, but can increase it significantly depending on map data.
Write compressed cache files with LZ4 high compression. This can reduce disk usage further, but costs more CPU while saving pages.
When running .fastmap cleanupcache, keep the newest pages-vN folder in each world cache and delete only older page-version folders.
Also write generated FastMap terrain tiles back to Vintage Story's vanilla map database. Disabled by default so FastMap only writes its own page cache.
Delete stale <world>.db-wal and <world>.db-shm files once on startup before FastMap opens the vanilla map database.
Adds a toggleable world-map overlay generated from Algernon's Terrain Sampler rainfall values. Requires Terrain Sampler column sample support.
Adds a toggleable world-map overlay generated from Algernon's Terrain Sampler temperature values. Requires Terrain Sampler column sample support.
Adds a toggleable world-map overlay generated from Algernon's Terrain Sampler forest density values. Requires Terrain Sampler column sample support.
Adds a toggleable world-map overlay generated from Algernon's Terrain Sampler shrub density values. Requires Terrain Sampler column sample support.
Synthetic terrain-sampler map resolution. 1 stores and samples every pixel; 4 stores one pixel per 4x4 page area; larger values are faster and smaller.
When true-colour world maps are enabled, use sparse loaded-surface block colour probes to improve synthetic terrain-sampler fallback pages without sampling every pixel.
Sparse fallback true-colour probe spacing in low-resolution fallback cells. 4 means one loaded-surface colour probe per 4x4 fallback cells.
Synthetic terrain-sampler fallback pixels at or above this height can use the snow palette when adjusted temperature is below vanilla's snow threshold.
How many times per in-game year uploaded Pregen fallback textures are re-tinted from the neutral disk cache. Higher values track seasons more smoothly but cause more GPU re-uploads.
Base #RRGGBB colour used for synthetic Pregen water before rainfall, temperature, and value-noise overlays are applied.
Light-blue #RRGGBB overlay applied inversely by rainfall. 0% rainfall applies this at full alpha before strength scaling.
Strength of the inverse-rainfall blue overlay. 0 disables it; 1 uses the configured colour at its calculated alpha; 2 exaggerates it before clamping.
Warm #RRGGBB overlay applied by adjusted temperature. 0% temperature applies no warmth.
Strength of the temperature warmth overlay. 0 disables it; 1 uses the configured colour at its calculated alpha; 2 exaggerates it before clamping.
Strength of subtle deterministic value noise applied after rainfall and temperature overlays. 0 is perfectly flat.
When true-colour map generation samples air at the rain-height surface, scan downward for a real block before colouring the pixel. This helps avoid white cave-mouth pixels.
Maximum number of blocks below the rain-height surface to search for a real block when repairing air true-colour samples.
Hex colour used when true-colour map generation still resolves to air after the air-surface repair search.
Maximum synthetic terrain-sampler pages FastMap may build per world session. Keeps the experiment bounded while testing.
Maximum chunk radius around the player where synthetic terrain-sampler pages may be built. Set to 0 for no radius limit.
Maximum missing fallback pages to queue per background generation pass while the world map is closed.
Maximum terrain-sampler fallback pages to build in parallel. Higher values fill distant fallback maps faster but can compete for CPU.
Maximum retry attempts for a synthetic terrain-sampler page if cache load or generation fails.
Delay before retrying a failed synthetic terrain-sampler page.
How much larger than the visible map viewport FastMap should keep loaded. 1.5 means 150% of the viewport.
How many extra page rings around the current loaded viewport may remain queued. 0 drops all queued page work outside the current viewport rectangle.
Generate and cache nearby map tiles in the background as you play.
Radius around the player to prewarm when nearby-tile prewarming is enabled.
Regenerate cached map pixels for chunks marked dirty by the game.
Maximum map tiles FastMap may process in one background worker pass.
Maximum number of page cache load tasks that may run at once.
Maximum number of page textures uploaded to the GPU per client tick.
Approximate main-thread time budget for applying ready map textures each tick.
Seconds between background cache work passes.
Seconds between nearby-tile prewarm scans.
Seconds between writing pending cached page snapshots to disk.
Flush pending page snapshots when this many pages are waiting to be saved.
Write periodic FastMap cache statistics to client-main.log. Useful for diagnostics, noisy for normal play.
Seconds between FastMap cache stat log lines when stat logging is enabled.
Log the first near-white true-colour sample per block type, including base/random/final colours and block colour-map metadata. Useful for diagnosing white rock map pixels.
Log slow FastMap tick/render/off-thread passes to client-main.log. Leave disabled outside diagnostics.
Minimum FastMap pass duration to log when hitch diagnostics are enabled.
